basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior AI Architect · Production LLM Systems · Hands-On Tech Lead · MBA
basics.summary: Hands-on AI architect, 13+ years building production systems. Owns AI agent architecture end-to-end at LumApps (LangChain, FastAPI, GCP, eval harness): $4M/quarter approved pipeline forecast, 2x open rates. Six years as Technical Lead at Beekeeper architecting distributed, event-driven systems (Kafka, microservices, Kubernetes) and shipping production LLM pipelines, including one that replaced a $337K vendor contract in 6 weeks. Built SwissNRI under FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss regulatory constraints; mentored AI engineering cohorts at Beekeeper and 20+ startups at Tenity. MBA, Zurich-based.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI agent architecture end-to-end, from production design through company-wide rollout. Hands-on architecture leader reporting directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress.
highlights: Designed, built, and deployed production AI agents for outbound sales. Architecture: LangChain, FastAPI, GCP, RAG, multi-agent runtime, eval harness (offline and online), governance. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $4M/quarter approved pipeline forecast.
Owned the full LLM application lifecycle: prompt management, evals, drift monitoring, reproducibility, auditability. Cloud-native, observability-first, designed for production reliability.

Expanded scope to own company-wide AI transformation strategy, governance, and sales enablement. Defines architectural standards across product, sales, and CS; bridges engineering with risk and compliance.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Hands-on technical lead. Owned architecture, design reviews, and production delivery of AI-powered products used by millions. Distributed, event-driven systems engineered for enterprise reliability.
highlights: Replaced $337K annual vendor translation contract with a production LLM pipeline (GitHub Actions, OpenAI APIs) shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated; model and prompt lifecycle, evals, and auditability owned in-house.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist, a production agent guiding 100% of new signups through personalized setup at scale. Architected end-to-end from design through monitoring.

Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead of the Incubation team (reporting to CIO). Event-driven, microservices, Kafka-backed, designed for 99.99% SLA. Platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR).
Acting hiring manager for the AI engineering cohort. Led architecture and design reviews, mentored engineers who now lead features independently, raised engineering standards across teams.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Member of the Technology Evaluation Panel for a Swiss fintech accelerator. Architecture reviewer and technical mentor for seed-to-VC stage AI and fintech startups.
highlights: Led architecture and AI-readiness reviews for 20+ startups (scalability, model risk, MLOps maturity) to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production. Advised on observability, reliability, and platform architecture.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off autonomous drone delivery startup. Designed and built the platform architecture end-to-end: distributed services, real-time APIs, and the cloud infrastructure underneath.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS). Distributed system architecture, real-time flight control APIs, 500+ successful deliveries.
Built CI/CD pipeline and AWS infrastructure from scratch. Infrastructure-as-code, enterprise-grade reliability that enabled Unilever partnership and CES Las Vegas showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Architected and scaled Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms. Foundational work that underpins my current agentic systems craft.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Multi-agent autonomous systems, distributed simulation pipeline.
Migrated simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs. Infrastructure-as-code, secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research, featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, learning from environment) that informs how I design modern LLM and agentic systems today.

projects.name: SwissNRI - Cross-border Fintech Platform
projects.description: Cross-border fintech platform for Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss regulatory constraints. Compliance-first architecture built into the foundation, not bolted on.
highlights: Zero-to-MVP in 3 months. Regulatory guardrails for both jurisdictions designed into the architecture before features.
Customer feedback loops drove 40% uplift in satisfaction. Roadmap owned by what users actually asked for.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time stock market analysis platform where AI agents generate AND justify trading signals. Explainability and auditability as core architectural constraints, not afterthoughts.
highlights: Production AI agents for real-time market analysis. Signal generation and justification, with explainability built into the architecture.
Opened to retail traders after self-validating. Now serving live users with real-time market feeds.

projects.name: Proplab - AI Real Estate Tools
projects.description: AI-powered tools for small real estate teams. MVP replacing paper-based property inspections with structured, image-backed, timestamped digital records.
highlights: Shipped MVP replacing paper-based inspection workflows with structured, image-backed, timestamped records.
Building AI marketing assistant that auto-generates property listings from inspection data.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Vontobel (Zurich, family-owned wealth management firm) is hiring a Senior AI Architect to own enterprise AI architecture: LLM and agent-based systems, RAG, MLOps, governance, distributed and event-driven platforms. Hands-on architecture leader, not purely strategic. 8+ years SWE, several years in architecture/tech leadership. Python, modern APIs, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Azure preferred. Regulated environment (banking/finance), collaborates with Security, Risk, Compliance, IT. Leads AI Developer Guild. On-site Zurich, 80 to 100%. German a strong plus.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit: production AI agents (LumApps), distributed event-driven systems (Beekeeper Kafka/microservices), production LLM pipelines (Beekeeper translation), architecture review track record (Tenity), regulated fintech experience (SwissNRI under FEMA/DTAA/Swiss). Mentoring/cohort leadership maps to AI Developer Guild. Zurich-based. Gaps: no Azure (has AWS + GCP), no German.
